body:
## Why
The live half of the board (locks, open attempts, events) and an index over the durable half need a store four kinds of process can query without loading the branch (`docs/local-first.md` §6.1, §6.3).

## What
`src/store/sqlite.js`, exporting an `Index` used by the local store (A6 composes it with A4's branch):
- Opens `.git/hkb/index.db` under `storeRoot(ctx)` (from A3) with `node:sqlite`'s `DatabaseSync`; `PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL`; `timeout` per §6.3; the schema of §6.3 created once, guarded by a `schema_version` row.
- `load(tree)`: replaces the indexed tables (`board`, `tasks`, `links`, `runs`, `attempts` closed rows, `results`) from a tree of A4's shape and stores `tip_sha`; cheap enough to run on every open when the tip differs.
- `claim(n, k)`: `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`; insert into `locks` (UNIQUE(task_id, k) violated → `held`); insert the open attempt row; set `tasks.status = 'running'`; append the event; `COMMIT` → `{ result: 'claimed', token }`. `release(n, k)` deletes the lock and appends an event. `heartbeat(n, k, expected)` is the single `UPDATE … WHERE token = ?`; zero rows → `'lost'`.
- `listLocks()`, `lockBeatAt(n, k)`, the open-attempt live fields (`pid`, `job`, `wt`, `heartbeat_at`, `paused_at`, `pauses_json`) read and written here, never on the branch.
- `events({ after, limit })` over `events.id`; **every mutating method appends one event** (`{ kind, task_id, payload_json }`, kinds from `src/watch.js`'s `EVENT_KINDS` plus `paused`, `resumed`, `stopped`, `suspended`).
- `wake()`: sends `SIGUSR1` to the pid in `.kanban/dispatch.pid` when it names a live process; never throws.
- A read-only connection factory for `hkb serve` (`timeout: 0`).

Tests (`test/store-sqlite.test.js`): a temp dir per test; the claim is atomic under two processes racing (spawn two `node -e` claimers, exactly one wins); heartbeat lost after release; `load()` twice with a changed tree replaces cleanly; every mutating call appends exactly one event; `wake()` with no pid file is a no-op. Register the driver in `DRIVERS` of `test/store.test.js` for the live methods and the events invariant.

## Done when
- [ ] `npm test` green on Node 22 and 24 (the 22 warning is silenced by A1's filter; assert an empty stderr once).
- [ ] The two-process claim race test exists and passes ten times in a row (`for i in 1..10` in the PR description, not in CI).
- [ ] No `git` call anywhere in the module.

## Contract
The schema of §6.3 and the method names of §6.4 for what this tier implements (`capabilities` → `{ events: true }`, `claim`, `release`, `listLocks`, `lockBeatAt`, `heartbeat`, `events`, plus the live attempt fields). Branch writes are **not** this tier's (A4). A4 runs beside you: touch nothing outside your `paths`.

**Read first:** `docs/local-first.md` (the plan; the sections named below), `docs/wiki/decisions/adr-005-control-plane.md`,
`docs/wiki/decisions/adr-006-local-store.md`, `CLAUDE.md`. Keep it dependency-free at runtime. Pure logic in
`src/model.js` with a test. Errors name the fix and carry `.exitCode`. `--json` everywhere. Update the wiki page a
change touches (`node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs` lists what went stale); a new feature gets a new page.
Finish with `npm run lint && npm test` green, one draft PR, and exactly one terminal verb.
goal: src/store/sqlite.js implements the schema of docs/local-first.md §6.3 with a one-transaction claim, a row-count heartbeat, an events cursor and a rebuild from a given tree; the conformance suite passes for the live methods and the events invariant
title: The index: src/store/sqlite.js — node:sqlite under the common git dir, the transactional claim, the events table
